metric_definitions.ratios: Each ratio stores numerator, denominator and nullable value; zero denominator means null.
metric_definitions.tokens: Input/output/reasoning separate known subtotals, missing rows and coverage; no missing-as-zero or double-sum.
metric_definitions.costs: Request latency, simulated activity minutes and session wall clock remain separate.
metric_definitions.pairing: 24 pairs from 12 states and two repeats; not 24 independent population samples.

fixture_contract.catalog_changes: None: existing object IDs, names, capabilities, prices, durations and 120-episode series retained.
fixture_contract.initial_settings: Only isolated genesis actor money/hunger and object stock overrides; seed validates genesis. No SQL production-state rewrites.
fixture_contract.generated_settings: Existing BUY, TRAVEL, MEAL, WATCH and PAUSE/CANCEL commands; all effects and history retained.
fixture_contract.invariants: validate_world PASS; no ACTIVE or PAUSED commitment at decision time; nonempty feasible set; prompt budgets enforced.
fixture_contract.family_comparison: Family members cover related states, not matched causal comparisons. Generated time, actor version, inventory, money, stock, events and commitments can differ; recipes document this.
fixture_contract.causal_pair: Only A/B copies of the same scenario/repeat must have identical initial state, observation, object candidates and feasible-set hashes.
